title: 第29章 你说你惹他干嘛
content_zh:
第29章 你说你惹他干嘛-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》

燕影厂招待所，三楼发生的事儿很快就传开了。不少演员都跑到三楼的楼道里打听发生了什么事情，得知事情经过后，三三两两站在楼道里看热闹。
“你们刚才是没看见，揪着领子左右开弓，啪啪啪的，哎呦喂，那是脸啊，能当成屁股打吗？”一个青年人穿着大裤衩，吐沫横飞，讲到激动处，还拿着手在空中比划。
“哎呦，朱新运惨喽，就是屁股也不能这样打啊！”女生说话时脸都皱到一块，京腔拖着长长的尾音，好似挨打的是她。
“这人谁啊？出手利索，真是盖了帽儿，以前没见过啊。”
“你们发现没，人家住的是单间！”
“单间怎么了？单间也不能打人啊。得，你们瞧好吧，朱新运去找厂领导去了，明天这事儿准得闹起来。”
梁晓生怕刘济民再冲动，在屋子里一个劲儿地劝架消火，甚至还拿自己的事儿来宽慰刘济民。
“明天要是领导找了，也别硬顶。人嘛，总会受点委屈。你拿我来说吧，来燕影厂没多久，每天早上屁颠屁颠地跑到办公室打扫卫生，端茶倒水，可有时候领导还不满意，你让我找谁说理去。”
刘济民没仔细听梁晓生的话，而是起身走到门口，外面的声音怎么那么像蔡茗儿啊。
蔡茗儿正站在门口一个劲儿地支着耳朵听里面的动静，却不料刘济民忽然打开了房门，两个人来了一个大眼瞪小眼。
刘济民上前一步，吓得蔡茗儿缩了缩脖子，梁晓声跑过来挡在刘济民身前：“济民同志，不至于，不至于！”
“你叫什么名字？”
“蔡茗儿，怎么着？你还想打我？”蔡茗底气不足地问道。
“我是解放军，保护老百姓，打你干什么？”
此时的蔡茗儿还没有长开，脸蛋看起来肉肉的。相比之下，还是她现在可爱。
梁晓生听到刘济民的话，松了一口气，忙喊着让周围的人散去。
周围的人看着刘济民人高马大，自觉不是对手，一个个都转身回了自己宿舍，有人用余光偷偷瞥刘济民，想知道到底是何方神圣。
“济民同志，我也走了，你早点休息吧！”
“行，麻烦你了！”

What happened on the third floor of Yanyingchang Guest House spread quickly. Many actors ran to the corridor on the third floor to find out what happened. After learning what happened, they stood in the corridor in twos and threes to watch the excitement.
"You didn't see it just now, grabbing the collar and shooting left and right, snap, snap, snap, oh, that's the face, can it be spanked as a butt?" A young man wearing big pants, spitting and gesticulating with his hands in the air when he got excited.
"Oh, Zhu Xinyun is miserable, you can't spank like this even on the butt!" The girl's face wrinkled up as she spoke, with a long Beijing accent, as if she was the one being spanked.
"Who is this person? He's so sharp and skillful. He's really a hater. I've never seen him before."
"Have you noticed that I live in a single room?"
"What's wrong with the private room? You can't hit people in a private room. Well, just look at it. Zhu Xinyun went to find the factory leader. There will definitely be a fuss about this matter tomorrow."
Liang Xiao was afraid that Liu Jimin would be impulsive again, so he kept trying to stop the fight in the room, and even comforted Liu Jimin with his own affairs.
"If the boss comes to see you tomorrow, don't hold on. People will always feel wronged. Take me for example. Not long after I came to Yanying Factory, I rushed to the office every morning to clean up and serve tea and water. But sometimes the boss is still not satisfied. Who do you want me to talk to for explanation?"
Liu Jimin didn't listen carefully to Liang Xiaosheng's words, but got up and walked to the door. The voice outside sounded so much like Cai Ming'er.
Cai Ming'er was standing at the door, listening to what was going on inside. Unexpectedly, Liu Jimin suddenly opened the door, and the two of them stared at each other.
Liu Jimin took a step forward, making Cai Ming'er shrink back in fear. Liang Xiaosheng ran over and stood in front of Liu Jimin: "Comrade Jimin, it won't happen, it won't happen!"
"What's your name?"
"Cai Ming'er, what's wrong? Do you still want to hit me?" Cai Ming asked without confidence.
"I am the People's Liberation Army and I protect the people. Why are I beating you?"
At this time, Cai Ming'er had not yet grown, and her face looked fleshy. In comparison, she is still cute now.
Liang Xiaosheng breathed a sigh of relief when he heard Liu Jimin's words and hurriedly shouted to the people around him to disperse.
The people around him looked at Liu Jimin's tallness and felt that he was no match. They all turned around and went back to their dormitories. Some people glanced at Liu Jimin secretly from the corner of their eyes, wondering who he was.
"Comrade Jimin, I'm leaving too. You should rest early!"
"Okay, please!"
